initial_root_entries.title: Review claim meaning after citation membership passes
initial_root_entries.body: When research rows have populated cells and matching citation substrings, perform a separate semantic review using the rows and relevant fetched evidence. Check whether each quote supports the specific claim, entity, attribute and requested time. Distinguish nationality, legal citizenship, ancestry and birthplace; distinguish historical status from concurrent status, and an institution listed for an event from an active employment role. An omitted attribute does not contradict a more complete explicit source. Treat ambiguous country lists as unresolved until their meaning is established. Turn review findings into targeted searches or focused refetches; reuse cached alternatives when a source fails. Preserve original quote spelling, and obtain supporting fetched evidence before replacing disputed exact wording. Validate proposed patches for existing entity keys, schema and quote membership before applying them. Recheck affected claims and final coverage. Quote membership and complete constraint logging support traceability but do not independently establish semantic correctness.

after.title: Recover failed or incomplete fetches without repeating exhausted sources
after.body: When a fetch batch returns FETCH_FAILED, preserve completed searches and inspect cached hits for untried relevant alternatives. Compare URLs against recorded attempts: selecting the first PDF can repeat a failed URL. Do not infer that unusual URL suffixes caused failures or that PDFs will succeed. If failures span HTML and PDFs on one host, try a discovered authoritative alternative publisher rather than exhausting that host's variants; search again where cached alternatives are inadequate. Distinguish transport failure from a successful response that omits required facts. If a request for a full announcement yields a refusal or sparse excerpt, retry only the affected pages with a bounded request for concise factual fields and short necessary quotations. Judge recovery by field coverage, not response length or success status alone. Preserve earlier fetched versions by URL before refetching, since rendered responses can change. Extract citations only from successfully fetched text and verify each quote against its retained response.
